versions.subject: refactor: plink usage / tunneling
versions.detection:
selection_a:
   Image|endswith: '\plink.exe'
   CommandLine|contains: ':127.0.0.1:3389'
selection_b1:
   Image|endswith: '\plink.exe'
   CommandLine|contains: ':3389'
selection_b2:
   CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -P 443'
      - ' -P 22'
condition: selection_a or all of selection_b*
